checked_claims.assessment: Cooperative word association, four clues per board, reconstruction and team high score are accurate; optional Add a Challenge is explicitly excluded and no standard mechanic is omitted by that exclusion.
220 Keyword cards, six boards, six markers, one Record of Legends and rulebook all match.
Board and marker per player; shuffled face-down common deck within reach; four cards per board placed randomly in recessed spaces and concealed from others.
Everyone works simultaneously and secretly; eight outside-edge Keywords form four Pairs, each two Keywords below a Clue Zone; a corresponding clue must connect both. Diagram supports this geometry.
checked_claims.source_refs: PDF p. 2 Choosing Clues and diagram

checked_claims.assessment: Single word with compounds allowed; common/proper nouns, acronym, number and onomatopoeia allowed. Keyword itself, translation, word family and invented word prohibited. Examples and difficult-pair advice are faithful.
Remove all four original cards; draw one unseen card; shuffle all five; board in front of owner and five-card face-down pile on top. Resolution waits for everyone to finish.

Choose first Spectator at Resolution; all other players reconstruct that board; Spectator cannot communicate except prescribed verification actions; each player spectates once; left neighbor decides disagreements and is next Spectator.

Reveal board and five cards centrally; rebuild correct Pairs by restoring the four original cards in correct spaces and orientations, leaving extra card outside. Verification diagram marks a rotated original card incorrect and shows an extra card outside, supporting explicit orientation requirement.
checked_claims.source_refs: PDF p. 4 Resolution; PDF p. 5 verification diagram

checked_claims.assessment: Players may discuss reasoning and try physical arrangements; Spectator verifies once players agree; left neighbor settles disputed placement.
Perfect first placement scores four card points plus two bonus points, total six. Otherwise Spectator silently removes incorrect cards to middle of table and grants one second and final attempt.

After agreement, remove any remaining incorrect cards to middle of table; score one per correct card, zero through four; no two-point bonus or third attempt. Summary correctly distinguishes cards from Keywords/Pairs.
Turn board over, write points in middle, discard all five used cards; left neighbor becomes next Spectator. Applies after either first-try success or final attempt.
Game ends when every player has spectated once; sum board points, record team total in Record of Legends, compare with previous high score.
checked_claims.source_refs: PDF p. 6 End of the Game
